name: weekly-git-digest-env
_notes: networking.limited is a containment control (premortem #6/E2): the sandbox can ONLY reach GitHub + Notion. Booleans default false; allow_package_managers:true is needed to apt-install git.
curl/python3/jq are usually preinstalled in the sandbox — if a launch run can't find one, add it under packages.apt and recreate the env.
Hostnames only, no scheme. github.com is needed for git clone over HTTPS if you clone instead of using the REST API.
